text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—And so, happy birthday, Universe-san. How 
did you like it? This melodia of mine.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Songs by bands you "love"... Even if 
they're "known," they show a different 
"scintillation" through "GDAE."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Sounds of Earth's "SEDAM" was the 
sound of "reaching out"... Sfera.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my overflowing amore must have 
traveled straight from my fingertips into 
the strings.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. We achieved "AMRT" through 
"resonance." Fufu, music is—"METI" too, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A lovely smile, bellissima. I hope to see it during the next song as well.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: It seems I haven't played nearly enough to express all my amore for you... Care to accompany me for one more song, my lady?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The next melody is a Rapsodia d'Amore. If 
I were to name it, yes—"On the Day the 
Cosmos Was Born."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This is the "unknown"... Could it be—an 
"original"? Sphaira, so very Sphaira...!
